comments.body:
Comment `/request-review` to automatically request reviews from the following teams:

* [analytics-platform](https://dev.tw.ee/catalog/default/group/analytics-platform): notifications will be sent to [#analytics-platform-public](https://wise.enterprise.slack.com/archives/)

You can also request review from a specific team by commenting `/request-review team-name`, or you can add a description with `--notes "<message>"`

💡 If you see something that doesn't look right, check the [configuration guide](https://dev.tw.ee/catalog/default/component/platon/docs/plugins/pr_bot/pr_bot/#configuration_1).
